description: NVR, Inc., a Virginia corporation formed in 1980 as NVHomes, Inc., has as its primary business the construction and sale of single-family detached homes, townhomes and condominium buildings, all of which are primarily constructed on a pre-sold basis, and to more fully serve customers of its homebuilding operations it also operates a mortgage banking and title services business through a wholly owned subsidiary, NVR Mortgage Finance, Inc. It conducts its homebuilding activities directly and is one of the largest homebuilders in the United States, operating in thirty-seven metropolitan areas in sixteen states and Washington, D.C., with homebuilding operations under three trade names, Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes, and its backlog, representing homes sold but not yet settled, totaled 8,448 units and approximately $4.0 billion as of December 31, 2025.
